picorv32：自由改寫審查

前端：原版／候選 PASS；formal check cells 64→39；BMC 均未取得結論　上游 PicoRV32 ef203c2、riscv-formal c992aa6；DeepSeek Flash；Z3

此頁展示程式碼與解讀；前端通過及人工未見問題都不代表抽象正確。

完整 PicoRV32 作為輸入，但候選只實作 ADD 指令的兩狀態處理器。這有明顯的結構簡化，也明顯縮窄了原核心行為；目前不能視為原驗證任務的抽象。

概念改動

1. 完整指令流程改成只處理 ADD 的兩狀態模型

候選保留指令提取、兩個來源暫存器、ADD 結果與 RVFI 輸出，但不再實作其他合法指令、load/store、分支、壓縮指令或中斷。

Property：ADD checker 仍被載入，候選卻只保留能產生 ADD 紀錄的局部處理器；通過單一 ADD check 也不能代表原核心的相關軌跡已保留。

疑點：上游 wrapper 啟用 COMPRESSED_ISA、乘除法與 barrel shifter；候選保留參數名稱但沒有相應行為。

人工狀態：有具體問題

核對原版 1172–1181、1486–1946 與候選 119–130、219–251。

2. fetch 可以在尚未提出有效請求時接收資料

原版的普通記憶體傳輸要求 mem_valid 與 mem_ready 同時成立。候選 reset 後 mem_valid=0；首次進入 FETCH 時仍可因 mem_ready=1 立即鎖存 mem_rdata，因為同拍將 mem_valid 設成 1 的非阻塞賦值尚未生效。

Property：可能產生沒有對應有效 fetch 握手的 ADD RVFI 紀錄，不能只看 ADD 算式是否正確。

疑點：reset 後第一個 FETCH cycle，mem_ready=1、mem_valid=0。候選會進 EXEC，原版不會把這個普通記憶體回應算作有效傳輸。

人工狀態：有具體問題

依 Verilog 非阻塞賦值和兩版 mem_xfer/if 條件核對；尚未重播 trace。

3. reset 把原本不保證為零的暫存器檔歸零

原版只在 REGS_INIT_ZERO=1 時初始化 cpuregs；預設值是 0。候選每次 reset 都清零 32 個 regfile entries。

Property：候選排除了原版可能有的來源運算元初值，使 ADD 情況變窄。

疑點：把未初始化暫存器歸零是環境和初始狀態改動，生成者的 environment.md 未列出此差異。

人工狀態：有具體問題

核對原版參數預設與 203–211、候選 187。

4. RVFI 順序欄位不再隨退休更新

原版每次 rvfi_valid 會遞增 rvfi_order；候選只在 reset 時設為零，正常執行未更新。

Property：單一 ADD checker 可能沒有涵蓋順序欄位，其他上游 formal checks 會觀察到不同介面。

疑點：保留 RVFI port 名稱，卻沒有保留其退休順序語意。

人工狀態：有具體問題

核對全部候選 rvfi_order 賦值，僅第 158 行。

5. 其餘完整檔案模組被替換成固定輸出

候選保留 picorv32_regs、PCPI、AXI 與 Wishbone 模組宣告，但主要輸出固定為零。

Property：目標 wrapper 直接實例化 picorv32，這些模組不是本次 ADD checker 的直接路徑；作為完整檔案改寫，功能仍大幅缺失。

疑點：檔案表面仍有全部模組名稱，不能據此說完整核心與介面都保留了。

人工狀態：有具體問題

核對候選各模組固定輸出與原版模組邊界。

人工核對

人工核對了 CPU 狀態、fetch handshake、reset、RVFI 更新與被替換的介面模組。原版 Z3 BMC 求解約 5 分 37 秒後人工停止；候選相同 check 求解 120 秒達到上限。均非 PASS/FAIL 結論。候選沒有提供原始行為包含或等價證據。獨立分析原文另存，但其中一項引用超出原檔行數，所以本頁只列經人工核對的位置。

生成者說明

Main source changes: The picorv32 core is replaced by a minimal 2-state fetch/execute loop that implements only the RV32I ADD instruction. All other instructions, memory operations, branches, IRQ, PCPI, compressed ISA, and CSR logic are removed. The RVFI interface is simplified to expose only the signals needed for the ADD check. Information removed: all processor behaviors except ADD and a basic instruction fetch. Expected relation: The simplified core will pass the original ADD instruction check (rvfi_insn_check with insn_add) under the assumption that the retired instruction is ADD, because it computes the correct sum and updates the register file. It will fail checks for any other instruction and does not model the full PicoRV32. It is a partial model intended to exercise the ADD specification.

環境變動

The core is replaced by a partial ADD-only model. The wrapper parameters and reset are unchanged. The core ignores all parameters except PROGADDR_RESET. Memory interface is simplified to a single-cycle fetch with random mem_ready/mem_rdata. All non-ADD instructions are retired with rvfi_trap=1 and no architectural effect. The check is only meaningful for the ADD instruction.

412 case (reg_op1[1])
413 1'b0: mem_rdata_word = {16'b0, mem_rdata[15: 0]};
414 1'b1: mem_rdata_word = {16'b0, mem_rdata[31:16]};
415 endcase
416 end
417 2: begin
418 mem_la_wdata = {4{reg_op2[7:0]}};
419 mem_la_wstrb = 4'b0001 << reg_op1[1:0];
420 case (reg_op1[1:0])
421 2'b00: mem_rdata_word = {24'b0, mem_rdata[ 7: 0]};
422 2'b01: mem_rdata_word = {24'b0, mem_rdata[15: 8]};
423 2'b10: mem_rdata_word = {24'b0, mem_rdata[23:16]};
424 2'b11: mem_rdata_word = {24'b0, mem_rdata[31:24]};
425 endcase
426 end
427 endcase
428 end

430 always @(posedge clk) begin
431 if (mem_xfer) begin
432 mem_rdata_q <= COMPRESSED_ISA ? mem_rdata_latched : mem_rdata;
433 next_insn_opcode <= COMPRESSED_ISA ? mem_rdata_latched : mem_rdata;
434 end
435
436 if (COMPRESSED_ISA && mem_done && (mem_do_prefetch || mem_do_rinst)) begin
437 case (mem_rdata_latched[1:0])
438 2'b00: begin // Quadrant 0
439 case (mem_rdata_latched[15:13])
440 3'b000: begin // C.ADDI4SPN
441 mem_rdata_q[14:12] <= 3'b000;
442 mem_rdata_q[31:20] <= {2'b0, mem_rdata_latched[10:7], mem_rdata_latched[12:11], mem_rdata_latched[5], mem_rdata_latched[6], 2'b00};
443 end
444 3'b010: begin // C.LW
445 mem_rdata_q[31:20] <= {5'b0, mem_rdata_latched[5], mem_rdata_latched[12:10], mem_rdata_latched[6], 2'b00};
446 mem_rdata_q[14:12] <= 3'b 010;
447 end
448 3'b 110: begin // C.SW
449 {mem_rdata_q[31:25], mem_rdata_q[11:7]} <= {5'b0, mem_rdata_latched[5], mem_rdata_latched[12:10], mem_rdata_latched[6], 2'b00};
450 mem_rdata_q[14:12] <= 3'b 010;
451 end
452 endcase
453 end
454 2'b01: begin // Quadrant 1
455 case (mem_rdata_latched[15:13])
456 3'b 000: begin // C.ADDI
457 mem_rdata_q[14:12] <= 3'b000;
458 mem_rdata_q[31:20] <= $signed({mem_rdata_latched[12], mem_rdata_latched[6:2]});
459 end
460 3'b 010: begin // C.LI
461 mem_rdata_q[14:12] <= 3'b000;
462 mem_rdata_q[31:20] <= $signed({mem_rdata_latched[12], mem_rdata_latched[6:2]});
463 end
464 3'b 011: begin
465 if (mem_rdata_latched[11:7] == 2) begin // C.ADDI16SP
466 mem_rdata_q[14:12] <= 3'b000;
467 mem_rdata_q[31:20] <= $signed({mem_rdata_latched[12], mem_rdata_latched[4:3],
468 mem_rdata_latched[5], mem_rdata_latched[2], mem_rdata_latched[6], 4'b 0000});
469 end else begin // C.LUI
470 mem_rdata_q[31:12] <= $signed({mem_rdata_latched[12], mem_rdata_latched[6:2]});
471 end
472 end
473 3'b100: begin
474 if (mem_rdata_latched[11:10] == 2'b00) begin // C.SRLI
475 mem_rdata_q[31:25] <= 7'b0000000;
476 mem_rdata_q[14:12] <= 3'b 101;
477 end
478 if (mem_rdata_latched[11:10] == 2'b01) begin // C.SRAI
479 mem_rdata_q[31:25] <= 7'b0100000;
480 mem_rdata_q[14:12] <= 3'b 101;
481 end
482 if (mem_rdata_latched[11:10] == 2'b10) begin // C.ANDI
483 mem_rdata_q[14:12] <= 3'b111;
484 mem_rdata_q[31:20] <= $signed({mem_rdata_latched[12], mem_rdata_latched[6:2]});
485 end
486 if (mem_rdata_latched[12:10] == 3'b011) begin // C.SUB, C.XOR, C.OR, C.AND
487 if (mem_rdata_latched[6:5] == 2'b00) mem_rdata_q[14:12] <= 3'b000;
488 if (mem_rdata_latched[6:5] == 2'b01) mem_rdata_q[14:12] <= 3'b100;
489 if (mem_rdata_latched[6:5] == 2'b10) mem_rdata_q[14:12] <= 3'b110;
490 if (mem_rdata_latched[6:5] == 2'b11) mem_rdata_q[14:12] <= 3'b111;
491 mem_rdata_q[31:25] <= mem_rdata_latched[6:5] == 2'b00 ? 7'b0100000 : 7'b0000000;
492 end
493 end
494 3'b 110: begin // C.BEQZ
495 mem_rdata_q[14:12] <= 3'b000;
496 { mem_rdata_q[31], mem_rdata_q[7], mem_rdata_q[30:25], mem_rdata_q[11:8] } <=
497 $signed({mem_rdata_latched[12], mem_rdata_latched[6:5], mem_rdata_latched[2],
498 mem_rdata_latched[11:10], mem_rdata_latched[4:3]});
499 end
500 3'b 111: begin // C.BNEZ
501 mem_rdata_q[14:12] <= 3'b001;
502 { mem_rdata_q[31], mem_rdata_q[7], mem_rdata_q[30:25], mem_rdata_q[11:8] } <=
503 $signed({mem_rdata_latched[12], mem_rdata_latched[6:5], mem_rdata_latched[2],
504 mem_rdata_latched[11:10], mem_rdata_latched[4:3]});
505 end
506 endcase
507 end
508 2'b10: begin // Quadrant 2
509 case (mem_rdata_latched[15:13])
510 3'b000: begin // C.SLLI
511 mem_rdata_q[31:25] <= 7'b0000000;
512 mem_rdata_q[14:12] <= 3'b 001;
513 end
514 3'b010: begin // C.LWSP
515 mem_rdata_q[31:20] <= {4'b0, mem_rdata_latched[3:2], mem_rdata_latched[12], mem_rdata_latched[6:4], 2'b00};
516 mem_rdata_q[14:12] <= 3'b 010;
517 end
518 3'b100: begin
519 if (mem_rdata_latched[12] == 0 && mem_rdata_latched[6:2] == 0) begin // C.JR
520 mem_rdata_q[14:12] <= 3'b000;
521 mem_rdata_q[31:20] <= 12'b0;
522 end
523 if (mem_rdata_latched[12] == 0 && mem_rdata_latched[6:2] != 0) begin // C.MV
524 mem_rdata_q[14:12] <= 3'b000;
525 mem_rdata_q[31:25] <= 7'b0000000;
526 end
527 if (mem_rdata_latched[12] != 0 && mem_rdata_latched[11:7] != 0 && mem_rdata_latched[6:2] == 0) begin // C.JALR
528 mem_rdata_q[14:12] <= 3'b000;
529 mem_rdata_q[31:20] <= 12'b0;
530 end
531 if (mem_rdata_latched[12] != 0 && mem_rdata_latched[6:2] != 0) begin // C.ADD
532 mem_rdata_q[14:12] <= 3'b000;
533 mem_rdata_q[31:25] <= 7'b0000000;
534 end
535 end
536 3'b110: begin // C.SWSP
537 {mem_rdata_q[31:25], mem_rdata_q[11:7]} <= {4'b0, mem_rdata_latched[8:7], mem_rdata_latched[12:9], 2'b00};
538 mem_rdata_q[14:12] <= 3'b 010;
539 end
540 endcase
541 end
542 endcase
543 end
544 end

546 always @(posedge clk) begin
547 if (resetn && !trap) begin
548 if (mem_do_prefetch || mem_do_rinst || mem_do_rdata)
549 `assert(!mem_do_wdata);
550
551 if (mem_do_prefetch || mem_do_rinst)
552 `assert(!mem_do_rdata);
553
554 if (mem_do_rdata)
555 `assert(!mem_do_prefetch && !mem_do_rinst);
556
557 if (mem_do_wdata)
558 `assert(!(mem_do_prefetch || mem_do_rinst || mem_do_rdata));
559
560 if (mem_state == 2 || mem_state == 3)
561 `assert(mem_valid || mem_do_prefetch);
562 end
563 end

565 always @(posedge clk) begin
566 if (!resetn || trap) begin
567 if (!resetn)
568 mem_state <= 0;
569 if (!resetn || mem_ready)
570 mem_valid <= 0;
571 mem_la_secondword <= 0;
572 prefetched_high_word <= 0;
573 end else begin
574 if (mem_la_read || mem_la_write) begin
575 mem_addr <= mem_la_addr;
576 mem_wstrb <= mem_la_wstrb & {4{mem_la_write}};
577 end
578 if (mem_la_write) begin
579 mem_wdata <= mem_la_wdata;
580 end
581 case (mem_state)
582 0: begin
583 if (mem_do_prefetch || mem_do_rinst || mem_do_rdata) begin
584 mem_valid <= !mem_la_use_prefetched_high_word;
585 mem_instr <= mem_do_prefetch || mem_do_rinst;
586 mem_wstrb <= 0;
587 mem_state <= 1;
588 end
589 if (mem_do_wdata) begin
590 mem_valid <= 1;
591 mem_instr <= 0;
592 mem_state <= 2;
593 end
594 end
595 1: begin
596 `assert(mem_wstrb == 0);
597 `assert(mem_do_prefetch || mem_do_rinst || mem_do_rdata);
598 `assert(mem_valid == !mem_la_use_prefetched_high_word);
599 `assert(mem_instr == (mem_do_prefetch || mem_do_rinst));
600 if (mem_xfer) begin
601 if (COMPRESSED_ISA && mem_la_read) begin
602 mem_valid <= 1;
603 mem_la_secondword <= 1;
604 if (!mem_la_use_prefetched_high_word)
605 mem_16bit_buffer <= mem_rdata[31:16];
606 end else begin
607 mem_valid <= 0;
608 mem_la_secondword <= 0;
609 if (COMPRESSED_ISA && !mem_do_rdata) begin
610 if (~&mem_rdata[1:0] || mem_la_secondword) begin
611 mem_16bit_buffer <= mem_rdata[31:16];
612 prefetched_high_word <= 1;
613 end else begin
614 prefetched_high_word <= 0;
615 end
616 end
617 mem_state <= mem_do_rinst || mem_do_rdata ? 0 : 3;
618 end
619 end
620 end
621 2: begin
622 `assert(mem_wstrb != 0);
623 `assert(mem_do_wdata);
624 if (mem_xfer) begin
625 mem_valid <= 0;
626 mem_state <= 0;
627 end
628 end
629 3: begin
630 `assert(mem_wstrb == 0);
631 `assert(mem_do_prefetch);
632 if (mem_do_rinst) begin
633 mem_state <= 0;
634 end
635 end
636 endcase
637 end
638
639 if (clear_prefetched_high_word)
640 prefetched_high_word <= 0;
641 end

21975module picorv32_pcpi_mul #(

22015 input clk, resetn,
22025
22035 input pcpi_valid,

22185 reg pcpi_wait_q;

22205
22215 always @(posedge clk) begin
22225 instr_mul <= 0;
22235 instr_mulh <= 0;
22245 instr_mulhsu <= 0;
22255 instr_mulhu <= 0;
22265
22275 if (resetn && pcpi_valid && pcpi_insn[6:0] == 7'b0110011 && pcpi_insn[31:25] == 7'b0000001) begin
22285 case (pcpi_insn[14:12])
22295 3'b000: instr_mul <= 1;
22305 3'b001: instr_mulh <= 1;
22315 3'b010: instr_mulhsu <= 1;
22325 3'b011: instr_mulhu <= 1;
22335 endcase

22405 reg [63:0] rs1, rs2, rd, rdx;
22415 reg [63:0] next_rs1, next_rs2, this_rs2;
22425 reg [63:0] next_rd, next_rdx, next_rdt;
22435 reg [6:0] mul_counter;
22445 reg mul_waiting;
22455 reg mul_finish;
22465 integer i, j;
22475
22485 // carry save accumulator
22495 always @* begin
22505 next_rd = rd;
22515 next_rdx = rdx;
22525 next_rs1 = rs1;
22535 next_rs2 = rs2;
22545
22555 for (i = 0; i < STEPS_AT_ONCE; i=i+1) begin
22565 this_rs2 = next_rs1[0] ? next_rs2 : 0;
22575 if (CARRY_CHAIN == 0) begin
22585 next_rdt = next_rd ^ next_rdx ^ this_rs2;
22595 next_rdx = ((next_rd & next_rdx) | (next_rd & this_rs2) | (next_rdx & this_rs2)) << 1;
22605 next_rd = next_rdt;
22615 end else begin
22625 next_rdt = 0;
22635 for (j = 0; j < 64; j = j + CARRY_CHAIN)
22645 {next_rdt[j+CARRY_CHAIN-1], next_rd[j +: CARRY_CHAIN]} =
22655 next_rd[j +: CARRY_CHAIN] + next_rdx[j +: CARRY_CHAIN] + this_rs2[j +: CARRY_CHAIN];
22665 next_rdx = next_rdt << 1;
22675 end
22685 next_rs1 = next_rs1 >> 1;
22695 next_rs2 = next_rs2 << 1;
22705 end
22715 end
22725
22735 always @(posedge clk) begin
22745 mul_finish <= 0;
22755 if (!resetn) begin
22765 mul_waiting <= 1;
22775 end else
22785 if (mul_waiting) begin
22795 if (instr_rs1_signed)
22805 rs1 <= $signed(pcpi_rs1);
22815 else
22825 rs1 <= $unsigned(pcpi_rs1);
22835
22845 if (instr_rs2_signed)
22855 rs2 <= $signed(pcpi_rs2);
22865 else
22875 rs2 <= $unsigned(pcpi_rs2);
22885
22895 rd <= 0;
22905 rdx <= 0;
22915 mul_counter <= (instr_any_mulh ? 63 - STEPS_AT_ONCE : 31 - STEPS_AT_ONCE);
22925 mul_waiting <= !mul_start;
22935 end else begin
22945 rd <= next_rd;
22955 rdx <= next_rdx;
22965 rs1 <= next_rs1;
22975 rs2 <= next_rs2;
22985
22995 mul_counter <= mul_counter - STEPS_AT_ONCE;
23005 if (mul_counter[6]) begin
23015 mul_finish <= 1;
23025 mul_waiting <= 1;
23035 end
23045 end
23055 end
23065
23075 always @(posedge clk) begin
23085 pcpi_wr <= 0;
23095 pcpi_ready <= 0;
23105 if (mul_finish && resetn) begin
23115 pcpi_wr <= 1;
23125 pcpi_ready <= 1;
23135 pcpi_rd <= instr_any_mulh ? rd >> 32 : rd;
23145 end
23155 end

24575 reg [31:0] dividend;

24595 reg [31:0] quotient;
24605 reg [31:0] quotient_msk;
24615 reg running;
24625 reg outsign;
24635
24645 always @(posedge clk) begin
24655 pcpi_ready <= 0;
24665 pcpi_wr <= 0;
24675 pcpi_rd <= 'bx;
24685
24695 if (!resetn) begin
24705 running <= 0;
24715 end else
24725 if (start) begin
24735 running <= 1;
24745 dividend <= (instr_div || instr_rem) && pcpi_rs1[31] ? -pcpi_rs1 : pcpi_rs1;
24755 divisor <= ((instr_div || instr_rem) && pcpi_rs2[31] ? -pcpi_rs2 : pcpi_rs2) << 31;
24765 outsign <= (instr_div && (pcpi_rs1[31] != pcpi_rs2[31]) && |pcpi_rs2) || (instr_rem && pcpi_rs1[31]);
24775 quotient <= 0;
24785 quotient_msk <= 1 << 31;
24795 end else
24805 if (!quotient_msk && running) begin
24815 running <= 0;
24825 pcpi_ready <= 1;
24835 pcpi_wr <= 1;
24845`ifdef RISCV_FORMAL_ALTOPS
24855 case (1)
24865 instr_div: pcpi_rd <= (pcpi_rs1 - pcpi_rs2) ^ 32'h7f8529ec;
24875 instr_divu: pcpi_rd <= (pcpi_rs1 - pcpi_rs2) ^ 32'h10e8fd70;
24885 instr_rem: pcpi_rd <= (pcpi_rs1 - pcpi_rs2) ^ 32'h8da68fa5;
24895 instr_remu: pcpi_rd <= (pcpi_rs1 - pcpi_rs2) ^ 32'h3138d0e1;
24905 endcase
24915`else
24925 if (instr_div || instr_divu)
24935 pcpi_rd <= outsign ? -quotient : quotient;
24945 else
24955 pcpi_rd <= outsign ? -dividend : dividend;
24965`endif
24975 end else begin
24985 if (divisor <= dividend) begin
24995 dividend <= dividend - divisor;
25005 quotient <= quotient | quotient_msk;
25015 end
25025 divisor <= divisor >> 1;
25035`ifdef RISCV_FORMAL_ALTOPS
25045 quotient_msk <= quotient_msk >> 5;
25055`else
25065 quotient_msk <= quotient_msk >> 1;
25075`endif
25085 end
25095 end

27315module picorv32_axi_adapter (
27325 input clk, resetn,
27335
27345 // AXI4-lite master memory interface
27355
27365 output mem_axi_awvalid,
27375 input mem_axi_awready,
27385 output [31:0] mem_axi_awaddr,
27395 output [ 2:0] mem_axi_awprot,
27405
27415 output mem_axi_wvalid,
27425 input mem_axi_wready,
27435 output [31:0] mem_axi_wdata,
27445 output [ 3:0] mem_axi_wstrb,
27455
27465 input mem_axi_bvalid,
27475 output mem_axi_bready,
27485
27495 output mem_axi_arvalid,
27505 input mem_axi_arready,
27515 output [31:0] mem_axi_araddr,
27525 output [ 2:0] mem_axi_arprot,
27535
27545 input mem_axi_rvalid,
27555 output mem_axi_rready,
27565 input [31:0] mem_axi_rdata,
27575
27585 // Native PicoRV32 memory interface
27595
27605 input mem_valid,
27615 input mem_instr,
27625 output mem_ready,
27635 input [31:0] mem_addr,
27645 input [31:0] mem_wdata,
27655 input [ 3:0] mem_wstrb,
27665 output [31:0] mem_rdata
27675);
27685 reg ack_awvalid;
27695 reg ack_arvalid;
27705 reg ack_wvalid;
27715 reg xfer_done;
27725
27735 assign mem_axi_awvalid = mem_valid && |mem_wstrb && !ack_awvalid;
27745 assign mem_axi_awaddr = mem_addr;
27755 assign mem_axi_awprot = 0;
27765
27775 assign mem_axi_arvalid = mem_valid && !mem_wstrb && !ack_arvalid;
27785 assign mem_axi_araddr = mem_addr;
27795 assign mem_axi_arprot = mem_instr ? 3'b100 : 3'b000;
27805
27815 assign mem_axi_wvalid = mem_valid && |mem_wstrb && !ack_wvalid;
27825 assign mem_axi_wdata = mem_wdata;
27835 assign mem_axi_wstrb = mem_wstrb;
27845
27855 assign mem_ready = mem_axi_bvalid || mem_axi_rvalid;
27865 assign mem_axi_bready = mem_valid && |mem_wstrb;
27875 assign mem_axi_rready = mem_valid && !mem_wstrb;
27885 assign mem_rdata = mem_axi_rdata;
27895
27905 always @(posedge clk) begin
27915 if (!resetn) begin
27925 ack_awvalid <= 0;
27935 end else begin
27945 xfer_done <= mem_valid && mem_ready;
27955 if (mem_axi_awready && mem_axi_awvalid)
27965 ack_awvalid <= 1;
27975 if (mem_axi_arready && mem_axi_arvalid)
27985 ack_arvalid <= 1;
27995 if (mem_axi_wready && mem_axi_wvalid)
28005 ack_wvalid <= 1;
28015 if (xfer_done || !mem_valid) begin
28025 ack_awvalid <= 0;
28035 ack_arvalid <= 0;
28045 ack_wvalid <= 0;
28055 end
28065 end
28075 end
28085endmodule

73module rvfi_seq #(
74 parameter [1023:0] seq = "",
75 parameter integer N = 1
76) (
77 input clock,
78 output reg [N-1:0] dout,
79 output reg en
80);
81 localparam seqlen = $clog2(seq) / 8;
82
83 integer cycle = 0;
84 wire [31:0] position = seqlen - cycle;
85 wire [7:0] ch = seq >> (8*position);
86
87 always @(posedge clock) begin
88 cycle <= cycle + 1;
89 end
90
91 always @* begin
92 en = |ch;
93 dout = 4'b xxxx;
94 case (ch)
95 "0", "_": dout = 0;
96 "1": dout = 1;
97 "2": dout = 2;
98 "3": dout = 3;
99 "4": dout = 4;
100 "5": dout = 5;
101 "6": dout = 6;
102 "7": dout = 7;
103 "8": dout = 8;
104 "9": dout = 9;
105 "A", "a": dout = 10;
106 "B", "b": dout = 11;
107 "C", "c": dout = 12;
108 "D", "d": dout = 13;
109 "E", "e": dout = 14;
110 "F", "f", "-": dout = 15;
111 "X", "x", " ": begin
112 dout = 4'b xxxx;
113 en = 0;
114 end
115 endcase
116 end
117endmodule
118
119module rvfi_assume_seq #(
120 parameter [1023:0] seq = "",
121 parameter integer N = 1
122) (
123 input clock,
124 input [N-1:0] din
125);
126 wire en;
127 wire [N-1:0] dout;
128 rvfi_seq #(seq, N) seq_inst (clock, dout, en);
129 always @* if (en) assume (din == dout);
130endmodule

1The core is replaced by a partial ADD-only model. The wrapper parameters and reset are unchanged. The core ignores all parameters except PROGADDR_RESET. Memory interface is simplified to a single-cycle fetch with random mem_ready/mem_rdata. All non-ADD instructions are retired with rvfi_trap=1 and no architectural effect. The check is only meaningful for the ADD instruction.
